text:
Ivy: Mystery mug alert — plain white mug labeled 'Property of the Republic' found in sink. Who's the Republic? :thinking:
Carlos: Oops. That was probably me from the retro. I left it, sorry. Leave it on the shelf and it's yours, Republic.
Mei: Is there a Republic mug club now? I want a membership card. :mug:
Ivy: We could institute a mug amnesty: unlabeled mugs go to the Lost & Found shelf on Fridays. Claim by Monday or they get rehomed.
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen policy update posted in #help. Unlabeled items moved to Lost & Found at 5pm Fridays. Automatic donation after 7 days.
Jordan: Shoutout to @Carlos for fixing the water dispenser last week. Cold water returns. :trophy:
Carlos: Thanks! Facilities requested kudos and offered free seltzer as reward.
Mei: One-liner: "My mug writes better commit messages than I do."
Theo: "Coffee: the office's unofficial transaction currency." :coffee:
Ivy: Quick poll: Should we add a tiny 'Republic' sticker to the mug shelf as a joke? React :+1: yes, :shrug: meh, :laughing: escalate to merch.
Jordan: :+1:
Carlos: :laughing: I second merch.
Mei: Also, tiny plea: label your mugs with name or emoji. Less soap drama. :soap:
OpsBot: New command: `/lostfound list` to view current items. Use `/claim <item>` to claim.
Ivy: OK we saved the Republic mug for now. If anyone wants to adopt it, bribe me with biscotti. Meeting adjourned to kitchen.
